fnol_text: My name is Ines Nakamura and I live at 416 Hawthorn Road, Riverton, WY 82560. You can reach me on (555) 630-9870 or ines.nakamura@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 11 August 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00137. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Nakamura on (555) 630-9870 to acknowledge the claim. Ines confirmed the loss date as 11 August 2025.
Site visit to 416 Hawthorn Road. Neighbour Ines Yilmaz was present and confirmed the timeline.
Ines sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
